answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree. The plume lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the quill is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zephyr of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
